$comment: Machine check for the load-bearing fork patches in FORK-PATCHES.md. An upstream merge that silently reverts one of these breaks publishing (P1 pushes to ghcr.io/ublue-os and gets a 403) or the zfs-aurora-complex consumer (P2). Each rule is a regex over one file: mustMatch must match, mustNotMatch must not.

rules.message: images.yaml must publish under org: danathar (FORK-PATCHES.md P1)
Justfile akmods_name must honour AKMODS_IMAGE_NAME (FORK-PATCHES.md P2)
Justfile akmods_name must default to the name in images.yaml (FORK-PATCHES.md P2)
build-prep.sh must install git so main-flavor ZFS builds can apply patches (FORK-PATCHES.md T6)
